def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    if isinstance(entity_ids, (pd.Series, list, np.ndarray)):
        prod_list = list(entity_ids)
    else:
        prod_list = [entity_ids]

    # Заказы, информация о которых уже известна на момент seed_time
    known_orders = orders[orders['order_purchase_timestamp'] < seed_time]
    known_order_ids = set(known_orders['order_id'])

    # Отзывы, уже созданные к моменту seed_time
    reviews_hist = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] < seed_time]

    # Платежи, уже совершённые к моменту seed_time
    payments_hist = payments[payments['ts'] < seed_time]

    # Выборка позиций нужных товаров, относящихся к известным заказам
    items = order_items[order_items['product_id'].isin(prod_list)]
    items = items[items['order_id'].isin(known_order_ids)]
    if items.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame({'has_sales': 0}, index=pd.Index(prod_list, name='product_id'))

    # Присоединяем известную информацию о заказах
    merged = items.merge(
        known_orders[['order_id', 'customer_id',
                      'order_purchase_timestamp', 'order_status',
                      'order_delivered_customer_date',
                      'order_estimated_delivery_date']],
        on='order_id', how='left'
    )
    merged = merged[merged['order_purchase_timestamp'] < seed_time]
    if merged.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame({'has_sales': 0}, index=pd.Index(prod_list, name='product_id'))

    # Флаги статуса заказа, известные на seed_time
    merged['is_delivered'] = (
        (merged['order_status'] == 'delivered') &
        (merged['order_delivered_customer_date'] < seed_time)
    ).astype(int)
    merged['is_canceled'] = (merged['order_status'] == 'canceled').astype(int)
    merged['is_unavailable'] = (merged['order_status'] == 'unavailable').astype(int)

    # Одна строка на (product_id, order_id)
    order_data = merged.groupby(['product_id', 'order_id']).agg(
        total_price=('price', 'sum'),
        total_freight=('freight_value', 'sum'),
        num_items=('order_item_id', 'count'),
        purchase_date=('order_purchase_timestamp', 'first'),
        is_delivered=('is_delivered', 'max'),
        is_canceled=('is_canceled', 'max'),
        is_unavailable=('is_unavailable', 'max')
    ).reset_index()

    # Агрегированные отзывы (только уже созданные к seed_time)
    reviews_agg = reviews_hist.groupby('order_id').agg(
        avg_review_score=('review_score', 'mean'),
        num_reviews=('review_score', 'count'),
        num_low_reviews=('review_score', lambda x: (x <= 2).sum()),
        num_high_reviews=('review_score', lambda x: (x >= 4).sum())
    ).reset_index()

    # Агрегированные платежи (только уже совершённые к seed_time)
    payments_agg = payments_hist.groupby('order_id').agg(
        avg_payment_value=('payment_value', 'mean'),
        num_payments=('payment_value', 'count'),
        sum_payment_value=('payment_value', 'sum'),
        max_installments=('payment_installments', 'max')
    ).reset_index()

    order_data = order_data.merge(reviews_agg, on='order_id', how='left')
    order_data = order_data.merge(payments_agg, on='order_id', how='left')

    fill_cols = ['avg_review_score', 'num_reviews', 'num_low_reviews',
                 'num_high_reviews', 'avg_payment_value', 'num_payments',
                 'sum_payment_value', 'max_installments']
    for col in fill_cols:
        order_data[col] = order_data[col].fillna(0)

    # Флаг наличия отзыва/платежа
    order_data['has_review'] = (order_data['num_reviews'] > 0).astype(int)
    order_data['has_payment'] = (order_data['num_payments'] > 0).astype(int)

    # Долгота по времени (маловажна сама по себе, но полезна как фаза сезона)
    order_data['purchase_month'] = order_data['purchase_date'].dt.month
    order_data['purchase_dow'] = order_data['purchase_date'].dt.dayofweek

    # Временные окна до seed_time
    for days in [30, 60, 90, 180, 365]:
        border = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=days)
        order_data[f'wd_{days}'] = (order_data['purchase_date'] >= border).astype(int)

    agg_dict = {
        'order_id': 'nunique',
        'total_price': ['sum', 'mean', 'std', 'max'],
        'total_freight': ['sum', 'mean'],
        'num_items': ['sum', 'mean'],
        'avg_review_score': ['mean', 'std'],
        'num_reviews': ['sum', 'mean'],
        'num_low_reviews': 'sum',
        'num_high_reviews': 'sum',
        'avg_payment_value': ['mean', 'std'],
        'num_payments': ['sum', 'mean'],
        'sum_payment_value': 'sum',
        'max_installments': 'max',
        'has_review': 'mean',
        'has_payment': 'mean',
        'is_delivered': 'mean',
        'is_canceled': 'mean',
        'is_unavailable': 'mean',
        'purchase_month': ['mean', 'std'],
        'purchase_dow': 'mean',
        'purchase_date': ['min', 'max', 'count']
    }
    for d in [30, 60, 90, 180, 365]:
        agg_dict[f'wd_{d}'] = 'sum'

    grouped = order_data.groupby('product_id').agg(agg_dict)
    grouped.columns = ['_'.join(c).strip('_') for c in grouped.columns.values]

    # Временные признаки, вычисленные относительно seed_time
    grouped['recency_days'] = (seed_time - grouped['purchase_date_max']).dt.days
    grouped['age_days'] = (seed_time - grouped['purchase_date_min']).dt.days
    grouped['days_from_first_order'] = (
        grouped['purchase_date_max'] - grouped['purchase_date_min']
    ).dt.days
    # Средний интервал между заказами
    grouped['order_rate'] = grouped['order_id_nunique'] / grouped['age_days'].replace(0, np.nan)

    grouped.drop(columns=[c for c in grouped.columns
                          if c.startswith('purchase_date_')], inplace=True)

    features = grouped.reindex(prod_list)

    has_sales = (features['order_id_nunique'].fillna(0) > 0).astype(int)
    features = features.fillna(0)
    features['has_sales'] = has_sales

    features = features.reindex(prod_list)
    features.index.name = 'product_id'
    return features
